changelog resolves the next version, collects the evidence of the commits
since the base version (each commit's record and, by default, its diff),
has the configured producer author a structured changelog from it, and
answers with the version, where the authored changelog is kept, and the
rendered changelog section. It writes CHANGELOG.md only with --write.

bump is major, minor or patch, and names the impact instead of inferring
it. The authored changelog is cached for the commit range, and reused
until --redo-notes. Exits 1 when no release is warranted.

Usage:
  release changelog [bump] [flags]

Flags:
      --corpus path     Read the corpus at this path instead of the cache when it exists, and write it there otherwise
  -h, --help            help for changelog
      --json            Render the answer as JSON instead of YAML
      --redo-notes      Discard any cached corpus and author again
      --skip-notes      Author with the mechanical producer instead of the configured one, and read no cache
      --target branch   The release line to collect from: a branch (default: the configured target, else the branch origin/HEAD points to)
      --write           Write the rendered section into CHANGELOG.md

Global Flags:
      --config file   Use this configuration file instead of discovering one
  -C, --repo path     Operate on the repository at this path instead of the working directory
